embeds.title: Download Venice
embeds.description: The installer below is the only official download. Venice is never distributed through DMs, file-sharing links or another server.

fields.name: 1 • Installer
fields.value:
[Download Venice Setup](INSTALLER_URL)
SHA-256: `INSTALLER_SHA256`
**Windows SmartScreen:** the installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Setup asks for administrator rights because it installs a controller driver.
**Check your download:** in PowerShell run `Get-FileHash $HOME\Downloads\VeniceSetup-*.exe` and make sure the hash matches the SHA-256 above. If it doesn't match, don't run it — open a ticket.

fields.name: 2 • Unlock it
fields.value: Launch Venice, then open [zaeorion.com/connect](https://zaeorion.com/connect), sign in with the **same Discord account** you use here, and enter the one-time code. No licence key is involved, and your Discord ID alone is not a code.

fields.name: 3 • First run
fields.value: Connect your 60 Hz capture card or PS5 Remote Play, confirm the game frame is visible, then follow <#1549499802738499705>.

fields.name: Moving PCs
fields.value: Access is locked to one PC. `/hwid_reset` gives you 3 free moves; after that each reset takes one day off your subscription.
